6165402.name: Chabad of Gerritsen Beach
6165402.note: Anash.org (19 Nov 2023, 'New Shluchim to Brooklyn's Gerritsen Beach'): Rabbi Mendel and Brochy Mann 'were appointed as the shluchim to Gerritsen Beach in Brooklyn, one of four new shluchim appointed under the auspices of Tzach'; 'The new shluchim's first major event was this past Chanukah' (Dec 2022, a public menorah lighting), then Yom Kippur services (Sept 2023). Its listing went up Nov 8 2023.

5566079.name: Chabad East Village
5566079.note: Anash.org (3 July 2022, 'New Shluchim to Manhattan's East Village'): 'Manhattan's East Village ... will now be home to a new Chabad house directed by Rabbi Meir and Tani Lerman', under Tzeirei Agudas Chabad. Its listing went up July 6 2022; they are on Merkos's list of 2022 'New Shluchim Grants' (Anash, 19 Nov 2022).

5300608.name: Mill Basin Jewish Center
5300608.note: Rabbi Mattisyohu and Chana Charytan, 'Mill Basin, NY', are on Merkos's list of 'New Shluchim Grants' given in the year to Nov 2022 (Anash, 19 Nov 2022), so they were new shluchim then; the listing went up Nov 4 2021. Medium: the year is the listing's; no report of their arrival found.
